name: Fotogenic AI – AI Image Studio
author: fotogenicai

sections.description:
Fotogenic AI adds an AI Photography Studio inside wp-admin for WordPress creators, WooCommerce teams, agencies, and brands that need faster visual production.

Instead of spending time writing instructions in different AI tools, testing random results, and updating products by hand, Fotogenic AI gives you one clear workflow built around guided selections.

In e-commerce, buyers often decide in seconds. Your product images help capture attention, shape first impressions, and influence whether a shopper keeps looking or moves on. Better visuals can make listings feel more trustworthy, more polished, and easier to buy from.

Use images already stored in WordPress, generate or enhance new visuals, review the results, and apply selected Product changes in one place.

Learn more about the WooCommerce product image generator:
https://fotogenic.ai/woocommerce-product-image-generator/

Built for real e-commerce work

Online stores need more than just AI image generation.

They need a practical way to:

  • Improve product presentation
  • Refresh old listings
  • Create more consistent visuals across the catalog
  • Update many products faster
  • Review changes before applying them

Fotogenic AI is built for that kind of work.

It helps turn existing product photos into new visuals through a guided workflow that is easier to manage and easier to repeat.

Great for

  • WordPress site owners and content teams
  • WooCommerce store owners
  • E-commerce teams
  • Agencies managing product catalogs
  • Brands that want faster image production inside WordPress

Features

Generate Images from Product, Media, Post, or Page

Create new visuals from a WooCommerce Product, a Media Library image, or the featured image of a Post or Page. Choose a guided recipe or use Fotogenic Visual Intelligence where Generate Images supports it.

Select one or many sources where supported

Generate Images supports one or multiple selected Products, Media Library items, Posts, or Pages in a run. Campaign Set supports one or multiple selected Products or Media Library items. Increase Resolution processes one Product or Media Library item at a time.

Depending on the selected source, multi-item selection can use:

  • Product search by name, SKU, or ID
  • Product category and stock filters
  • Media Library, Post, and Page selection where supported
  • Individual selections or all items matching the current filters

Create a Campaign Set

Turn 1 to 10 source images into a coordinated set of 2 to 6 campaign visuals. Campaign Set supports one or multiple selected Product or Media Library items per run, with optional subject and environment references and guidance. Only supported recipe options are shown, and no aspect ratio is forced.

Increase image resolution

Create a higher-resolution copy from one Product or Media Library source at a time, compare the original and enhanced result, and keep the saved derivative in WordPress. Sources are not overwritten.

Choose which Product images to use

Use the Product’s featured image, eligible gallery images, or both where the selected workflow supports multiple inputs.

Review results before changing your store

Fotogenic AI multi-item runs are built around efficient monitoring. You can:

  • Monitor item-by-item progress
  • Pause or stop active bulk jobs
  • Run jobs in the background
  • Review completed and partial results
  • Use the available Product result actions where the selected workflow supports them

Decide how generated images are applied

For eligible Product results, you can choose to:

  • Add it to the gallery
  • Replace the main product image
  • Replace the main product image and also add it to the gallery

Simple 3-step workflow

  1. Choose workflow and sources
    Select Generate Images, Campaign Set, or Increase Resolution, then choose one or multiple available items where the workflow supports it.
  2. Set the visual direction
    Set the options exposed for that workflow. Generate Images can also use supported references and Fotogenic Visual Intelligence; Increase Resolution intentionally has no recipe controls.
  3. Review the results
    Review saved Media Library results and use eligible Product actions when you want to update a catalog image.

Made for recurring workflows

Generate Images helps bring more order to repeatable image creation with:

  • Presets for repeated workflows
  • Global instructions for consistency across runs
  • Custom instructions for small adjustments

This makes it easier to create a more consistent visual style across many products rather than starting from zero every time.

External Service

Fotogenic AI connects to the Fotogenic AI service when you connect an account, refresh account-backed configuration or pricing, use Fotogenic Visual Intelligence, or start and monitor an image workflow. Depending on the action, the plugin sends the selected image files, chosen recipe options, and the account/session data required to fulfill the request. Images returned by completed workflows are saved as new attachments in your WordPress Media Library.

Review the Fotogenic AI Privacy Policy and current Pricing before using the service.

Pricing

To view current plans, credits, and pricing details, visit our Pricing page.

More Information

https://fotogenic.ai/

sections.installation:
How to install Fotogenic AI:

  1. Upload the fotogenic-ai folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it through Plugins -> Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Fotogenic AI -> Settings.
  4. Log in to your Fotogenic AI account.
  5. Open Fotogenic AI -> Studio and start your first workflow.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin add anything to my site’s front-end?

No. Fotogenic AI runs in wp-admin only. It does not add any frontend blocks, shortcodes, widgets, or tracking scripts.

Is WooCommerce required?

WooCommerce is required only for Product-backed workflows. Media Library, Post, and Page generation, Media Campaign Set, and Media Increase Resolution do not require WooCommerce.

What can I process in one run?

Generate Images supports one or multiple selected Products, Media Library items, Posts, or Pages. Campaign Set supports one or multiple selected Products or Media Library items. Increase Resolution processes one Product or Media Library item at a time.

Are source images overwritten?

No. Generated and enhanced files are saved as new Media Library attachments. Eligible Product placement changes require an explicit result action.

Can I control where generated images go?

For eligible Product results, yes. You can choose whether generated images should be added to the gallery, replace the main Product image, or do both. Media, Post, and Page sources keep their generated files in the Media Library.

Does the plugin work without a Fotogenic AI account?

The screens can load without a connected account and settings can still be adjusted, but image-generation actions require a connected Fotogenic AI account.

Do I need credits or paid service access?

Generation availability depends on your Fotogenic AI account status and available credits or service access.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Added Campaign Set generation for coordinated multi-image campaigns from Product or Media Library sources.
  • Added Increase Resolution with saved WordPress derivatives and before/after comparison.
  • Added one three-column Studio workflow with manifest-defined one-or-many selection across supported Product, Media, Post, and Page sources.
  • Added responsive welcome and low-credit experiences with one-time, account-aware eligibility.
  • Improved credit freshness metadata, billable-start concurrency protection, multi-output finalization, and workflow history.
  • Preserved WooCommerce-optional support for Media, Post, and Page generation and Media-based Campaign Set and Increase Resolution.

1.0.8

  • Compatibility with WordPress 7.0.

1.0.7

  • Maintenance release with minor plugin documentation improvements.

1.0.6

  • Fixed WooCommerce product gallery updates after generated images are added or removed from Studio.
  • Improved product cache refresh behavior so gallery and featured-image changes appear without extra page refreshes.
  • Improved compatibility with WooCommerce product image gallery extensions.

1.0.5

  • Maintenance release with minor usability refinements.

1.0.4

  • Improved bulk progress state handling and simplified the settings auth popup experience.

1.0.3

  • Maintenance release with minor usability refinements.

1.0.2

  • Improved WordPress compatibility and overall admin experience.

1.0.1

  • Improved the Studio and Settings UI styling.
  • Fixed the Settings tab rendering regression.
  • Refined picker and bulk workflow behavior.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
